content.short: Space Troopers is a P2E NFT project providing a sci-fi gladiator game enabling players to earn weekly $Ada in.
content.description: Space Troopers is an art and gaming project, with utility. We are offering 3d modelled art, each individually rendered and all unique from one another, highly detailed and stylised, with original traits and some inspired by classic sci-fi. We are aiming for our art to be good enough to be considered an art project outright, but we are also providing reasons to hold your Space Trooper by adding returns and utility. Some of our NFTs will offer passive income, Ada sent straight to the wallet containing them from a portion of secondary sales.
content.meta: Find out about Space Troopers (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
